## POST `/103/mainframe/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/split/{splitId}/storageProvisioningToHost`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

This call creates a controller resource that provisions storage for a mainframe host and maps the created volumes to the specified CU image. The mapping can be to an existing CU image or to a new CU image, if requested.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | The System ID |
| `splitId` | path | string | yes | The Split ID |

**Request body** (required): `storageProvisioningToHostParam`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `executionOption` | string (enum: `SYNCHRONOUS`, `ASYNCHRONOUS`) |  |
| `cu_Image` | `cuImageActionParam` | The details on the CU Image to be used (existing or new). |
| `create_Storage_Group` | `createStorageGroupParam` | The details on the storage group to be created. |

**Responses:** `201` Created → `storageGroup` · `202` Accepted · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `409` Conflict · `500` Internal Server Error
